final: WITH per AS (SELECT ordersmark AS ref, AVG(fillcount) AS a FROM orderexecutions WHERE ordersmark IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordersmark), overall AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS o FROM per), kept AS (SELECT ref, a FROM per, overall WHERE a > o), keptavg AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS k FROM kept) SELECT kept.ref, kept.a AS avg_fill, kept.a - overall.o AS diff_overall, kept.a - keptavg.k AS diff_kept FROM kept JOIN keptavg ON keptavg.k IS NOT NULL CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY diff_kept DESC LIMIT 10
